cases.name: Kailee Grace Warren
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Kailee was a student at Battle Creek Middle School. She enjoyed being outdoors and especially enjoyed the mountains, being in the water and on the beach. Kailee loved animals and animals loved her. She was always at peace when she was drawing, listening to music and playing games. She loved her friends and family deeply and will be missed by all who knew her."
